description: Strategic recommendations for addressing priority gaps. Includes solution mapping, implementation approach, expected outcomes, and KPI tracking.

recommendation_context.prospecting_disclaimer: All recommendations demonstrate alignment between identified gaps and solutions. Expected improvements and timeline are indicative only; subject to scoping and implementation complexity. No contractual or pricing commitments are implied.

strategic_recommendations.gap_analysis: [Root cause of why institution is behind peers; institutional context]

argument_chain.evidence: [Specific evidence supporting the claim: gap size, peer practice, regulatory context]
argument_chain.reasoning: [Why this specific action addresses the root cause]
argument_chain.rebuttal: [Why the objection is addressed or acceptable]

recommended_solutions.why_this_solution: [Why this solution is optimal for [Institution]'s specific situation and gap; not generic]
recommended_solutions.time_to_value: [Months from implementation start to capability improvement]

kpis_and_tracking.kpi: [E.g., 'Data element coverage: % of critical elements classified']

business_impact.strategic_impact: [How does this address institution's strategic objectives?]

dependencies_and_sequencing.prerequisite_capabilities: [Capabilities that must be in place first]
dependencies_and_sequencing.sequence_rationale: [Why this recommendation is positioned at this stage relative to others]
dependencies_and_sequencing.concurrent_initiatives: [Other gaps that could be addressed in parallel]

transformation_roadmap.description: Phased implementation plan across multiple priorities; no fixed date ranges (use milestone-based phases per skill standards)

roadmap_phases.included_recommendations: [List of REC IDs addressed in this phase]
roadmap_phases.success_gates: [Criteria that must be met before moving to next phase]

roadmap_phases.expected_score_progression: [Score trajectory; should approach or exceed peer median]

overall_roadmap_timeline.full_roadmap_duration: [Total estimated months from Phase 1 start to completion]
overall_roadmap_timeline.maturity_target: [Overall score target at end of roadmap, e.g., 3.2 → 3.8]

solution_portfolio_summary.description: Overview of recommended solutions and how they work together
solution_portfolio_summary.integrated_approach: [How solutions work together; synergies; avoid overlapping or redundant tooling]

alternative_approaches.description: Alternative strategies for addressing priority gaps; shows [Institution] has options based on risk tolerance and resources

alternative_1.timeline_impact: [Would this speed up or slow down implementation?]

investment_and_resource_planning.roi_considerations: [NOTE: Prospecting context; no specific ROI commitments. Typical benefits include: improved member satisfaction, operational efficiency gains, reduced compliance risk, increased digital revenue.]

overall_maturity_trajectory.peer_median_comparison: [How does final score compare to current peer median?]

governance_and_oversight.steering_committee: [Who should oversee implementation? CEO, Board committee, CIO, etc.]
governance_and_oversight.success_metrics_dashboard: [Monthly/quarterly tracking of KPIs across all recommendations]
governance_and_oversight.gating_process: [How to determine when phases are complete and gates satisfied]
governance_and_oversight.course_correction: [Process for adjusting roadmap if conditions change]

recommendation_argument_validation.description: All recommendations include full argument chain per skill Principle 2

solution_specificity_validation.check: No generic recommendations; all solutions explained for [Institution]'s specific context

no_roi_commitment_validation.check: Prospecting context maintained; no pricing or contractual language included
